resource.name: payment-gateway
resource.description: A payment processing service that handles charges and transactions for projects that need to process or handle payments.

config.description: Base URL of the Payment Gateway API (e.g. https://development-default.apps.94.72.97.95.sslip.io/internal-payments-api). No credential is required to call it.

resource.consumptionInstructions: Whenever any project needs to process or handle payments, use this resource. Call the API directly at the configured base URL — no API key or other credential is required beyond that. Generate a client from the published OpenAPI contract rather than hand-writing request/response shapes.
